CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Laboratory

PATIENT INFORMATION
Patient: [redacted name]
DOB: [redacted date]
MRN: [redacted ID]
Specimen Type: Amniotic Fluid
Collection Date: [redacted date]
Received Date: [redacted date]
Report Date: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INFORMATION
Reason for Referral: Advanced maternal age (34 years)
Gestational Age: 15 weeks by ultrasound
Clinical Indication: Prenatal screening for chromosomal abnormalities

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded Chromosome Analysis (Karyotype)

METHODOLOGY
Amniotic fluid cells were cultured and harvested according to standard protocols. Metaphase chromosomes were G-banded using trypsin-Giemsa staining. A minimum of 20 cells were analyzed at 400-550 band resolution. This analysis is designed to detect numerical abnormalities and major structural rearrangements (>5-10 Mb).

RESULT
Karyotype: 46,XX

Normal female karyotype

INTERPRETATION
No chromosomal abnormalities detected. The analysis shows a normal female chromosome complement with no evidence of trisomy 21 (Down syndrome) or other numerical or major structural chromosomal abnormalities.

LIMITATIONS
This test cannot detect:
- Balanced rearrangements that do not result in gain or loss of chromosomal material
- Microdeletions or microduplications below the resolution of conventional cytogenetics (~5-10 Mb)
- Low-level mosaicism (<20%)
- Single gene disorders
- Uniparental disomy

PREVIOUS TESTING
This result supersedes the preliminary rapid aneuploidy PCR analysis performed on [redacted date].

RECOMMENDATIONS
No further cytogenetic testing indicated based on these findings. Genetic counseling is available to discuss results and any additional testing considerations.

This test was performed in a laboratory accredited by CPA (UK) Ltd to the ISO 15189:2012 standard.

Reported by: [redacted name], Clinical Scientist
Authorized by: [redacted name], Consultant Clinical Geneticist
